summary: Franklin Wireless Corp. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose an adverse court ruling against its South Korean subsidiary, Franklin Technology Inc. (FTI). On July 28, 2026, the Seoul Central District Court ordered FTI to pay Partron Co., Ltd. approximately $3,673,336 USD plus pre-judgment interest at 5% per annum from November 4, 2022 through July 16, 2026, and ongoing post-judgment interest at 12% per annum from July 17, 2026. The dispute arises from a commercial contract for device development and production. FTI is reviewing the decision with counsel and considering an appeal. This is a routine litigation disclosure, not a special situation.
